opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small business owners and content creators looking to enhance their social media presence on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
opportunity.customer_problem: Small businesses struggle to create engaging short-form video content consistently, which limits their growth on social media platforms.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a comprehensive package that includes scripting, video content ideation, caption writing, and a tailored social media strategy focused on short-form video content.
deliverables: 5 short-form video scripts tailored for the business's products/services
5 video concepts including key visual elements and call-to-action suggestions
5 engaging captions optimized for each video
A custom content calendar for posting the videos
A one-hour consultation to refine video strategy and best practices
opportunity.next_action: Prepare a portfolio with sample short-form video content and testimonials to attract potential clients.
